kinds.d: Cut willow rods grown and sold for weaving baskets.

x.d: Willow valued for flexibility and ease of growing; willow baskets were commonly called wickerwork in England.

kinds.d: Cane, reed or wood splint sold for weaving baskets.

x.d: Reed is the inner core of the rattan vine and cane its bark; flat reed suits square baskets, oval reed round baskets, round reed twining.

kinds.d: Cord and tape for weaving chair seats.

x.d: Woven tape seating used on Shaker slat-back chairs, such as a c. 1840 Mount Lebanon side chair with brown striped tape seat.

kinds.d: Pre-woven cane sheet sold for seating and panels.
Palm-fibre strand sold for weaving and craft.
Packing tool, awl, reed gauge or peg made for basketry and caning.

traditions.d: Island baskets woven on a mold with rattan staves, cane weavers and a solid wood base.
traditions.auth: rattan staves, cane weavers, solid wood base

traditions.d: Chair seats woven from coloured tape on Shaker slat-back chairs.
traditions.auth: tape seat in checkerboard or herringbone weave
